questions.question: What info do you collect for my booking?
answer_facts: Booking details: names, email, phone number, dates, payment status.
ID details required by law at check-in (see "Guest ID and registration").

questions.question: So like, do u guys keep my data or what?
answer_facts: We don't sell personal data, and we only send marketing emails if you opt in.

questions.question: I’m just wondering if there are cameras in the villa for privacy reasons.
answer_facts: CCTV covers the gate and driveway only.
There are no cameras inside any villa.

questions.question: Can I get a copy of my personal data after my stay?
answer_facts: You can ask for a copy of your data or for it to be deleted (except where the law requires us to keep it, such as Form C records).
